headline: Stellar Blade hits Switch 2 this week
title: Stellar Blade Switch 2 November 5 | Launch Date | Gaming News
video_script: Stellar Blade is coming to Nintendo Switch 2. The Complete Edition launches worldwide on November fifth in the West, which is November sixth in Asia, from developer Shift Up. Four free Bayonetta inspired outfits for Eve arrive at the same time. The announcement came on September tenth, twenty twenty six. Will you play Eve's adventure on Switch 2? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Launch date in the West, 6 November in Asia

description: Stellar Blade Complete Edition launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026 in the West, with free Bayonetta outfits.
